scripts.build:android: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk dist/remus-recorder-release.apk
scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -workspace ios/remusapprecorder.xcworkspace -scheme remusapprecorder -configuration Release -archivePath ios/build/remusapprecorder.xcarchive -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/remusapprecorder.xcarchive -exportPath ios/build/release-ipa-adhoc -exportOptionsPlist ios/exportOptions-adhoc.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates && cp ios/build/release-ipa-adhoc/remusapprecorder.ipa dist/remus-recorder-release.ipa
scripts.build:release: npm run build:android && npm run build:ios
